sentences.en: As Davidson notes, "In the 10 years ending in 2009, [U.S.] factories shed workers so fast that they erased almost all the gains of the previous 70 years; roughly one out of every three manufacturing jobs - about 6 million in total - disappeared."
sentences.cn: 正如戴维森所言，“2009 年以前的十年间，（美国）工厂裁员如此之快，以至于抹掉了前 70 年所有新增员工的总额；制造业岗位中，大约有三分之一，共计将近 600 万个岗位不复存在。”

sentences.en: There will always be change - new jobs, new products, new services.
sentences.cn: 变化将会永远存在——新岗位，新产品，新服务。

sentences.en: But the one thing we know for sure is that with each advance in globalization and the I.T. revolution, the best jobs will require workers to have more and better education to make themselves above average.
sentences.cn: 但有一点我们确信无疑，随着全球化和信息技术革命的发展，最佳岗位将要求员工掌握更多、更好的教育，以使自己高于平均水平。

sentences.en: In a world where average is officially over, there are many things we need to do to support employment, but nothing would be more important than passing some kind of G.I. Bill for the 21st century that ensures that every American has access to post-high school education.
sentences.cn: 在一个已正式告别平庸的世界里，我们需要做很多事情以扶持就业，但对 21 世纪来讲，最重要的事情莫过于出台《美国退伍军人权利法案》之类的法案，以确保每个美国人都有机会接受高中后教育。

sentences.en: A century ago, the immigrants from across the Atlantic included settlers and sojourners.
sentences.cn: 一个世纪前，横跨大西洋来到美国的移民中既有定居者，也有旅居者。

sentences.en: Along with the many folks looking to make a permanent home in the United States came those who had no intention to stay, and who would make some money and then go home.
sentences.cn: 许多人希望在美国建立永久家园，但也有人无意长留于此，打算赚些钱后返回家乡。

sentences.en: Between 1908 and 1915, about 7 million people arrived while about 2 million departed.
sentences.cn: 1908 年至 1915 年间，约有 700 万人来到美国，而离开的大约有 200 万人。

sentences.en: About a quarter of all Italian immigrants, for example, eventually returned to Italy for good.
sentences.cn: 例如，约有四分之一的意大利移民最终永久返回了意大利。

sentences.en: They even had an affectionate nickname, "uccelli di passaggio," birds of passage.
sentences.cn: 他们甚至有个亲切的昵称，“uccelli di passaggio”，即“候鸟”。

sentences.en: Today, we are much more rigid about immigrants.
sentences.cn: 今天，我们对移民严格了许多。

sentences.en: We divide newcomers into two categories: legal or illegal, good or bad.
sentences.cn: 我们将新来者分为两类：合法或非法，好或坏。

sentences.en: We hail them as Americans in the making, or brand them as aliens to be kicked out.
sentences.cn: 我们或将其誉为“缔造中的美国人”，或将其归为“需要驱逐的异族”。

sentences.en: That framework has contributed mightily to our broken immigration system and the long political paralysis over how to fix it.
sentences.cn: 这一思维构架在很大程度上导致了我们的移民体系漏洞百出，也致使政府对“如何修复这一体系”处于长期瘫痪状态。

sentences.en: We don't need more categories, but we need to change the way we think about categories.
sentences.cn: 我们无需更多类别，但需要改变对类别的思考方式。

sentences.en: We need to look beyond strict definitions of legal and illegal.
sentences.cn: 我们需要超越对“合法”和“非法”的严格定义。

sentences.en: To start, we can recognize the new birds of passage, those living and thriving in the gray areas.
sentences.cn: 首先，我们可以认可那些“新候鸟”，那些于灰色地带生活并繁荣发展的人。

sentences.en: We might then begin to solve our immigration challenges.
sentences.cn: 之后，我们才有可能着手解决在移民方面面临的挑战。

sentences.en: Crop pickers, violinists, construction workers, entrepreneurs, engineers, home health-care aides and physicists are among today's birds of passage.
sentences.cn: 如今的“候鸟”中，有农作物收割工、小提琴手、建筑工人、企业家、工程师、家庭医疗保健助手以及物理学家等。

sentences.en: They are energetic participants in a global economy driven by the flow of work, money and ideas.
sentences.cn: 受工作、资金以及观念流动的驱使，他们成为全球经济的积极参与者。

sentences.en: They prefer to come and go as opportunity calls them.
sentences.cn: 他们愿意跟随机会的召唤或来或走。

sentences.en: They can manage to have a job in one place and a family in another.
sentences.cn: 他们可以设法在一个地方工作，在另一个地方安家。

sentences.en: With or without permission, they straddle laws, jurisdictions and identities with ease.
sentences.cn: 不管有无许可，他们都能轻松跨越法律、管辖区域以及身份。

sentences.en: We need them to imagine the United States as a place where they can be productive for a while without committing themselves to staying forever.
sentences.cn: 我们需要他们将美国视作一个能让他们有所成就而无需承诺永久居住的地方。

sentences.en: We need them to feel that home can be both here and there and that they can belong to two nations honorably.
sentences.cn: 我们需要他们感觉到既可以在美国安家、也可以在祖国安家，他们可以体面地属于两个国家。

sentences.en: Accommodating this new world of people in motion will require new attitudes on both sides of the immigration battle.
sentences.cn: 认可这样一个流动人员的新世界，需要“移民之争”双方都有新的态度。

sentences.en: Looking beyond the culture war logic of right or wrong means opening up the middle ground and understanding that managing immigration today requires multiple paths and multiple outcomes, including some that are not easy to accomplish legally in the existing system.
sentences.cn: 超越这种非对即错文化战争的逻辑，意味着要打开中间地带，并知晓当今的移民管理需要多种途径及多样结果，包括一些现有制度下通过法律难以达成的途径和结果。

sentences.en: Scientists have found that although we are prone to snap overreactions, if we take a moment and think about how we are likely to react, we can reduce or even eliminate the negative effects of our quick, hard-wired responses.
sentences.cn: 科学家已经发现：我们虽然易于做出快速过激反应，但是，如果花点时间揣度一下我们可能会做何反应，就可以减少甚至消除快速本能反应的负面影响。

sentences.en: Snap decisions can be important defense mechanisms; if we are judging whether someone is dangerous, our brains and bodies are hard-wired to react very quickly, within milliseconds.
sentences.cn: 快速决策可能是重要防御机制；如果要判断某人是否具有危险性，毫秒间我们的大脑和身体就会本能地快速做出反应。

sentences.en: But we need more time to assess other factors.
sentences.cn: 但是，我们需要更多时间来评定其他因素。

sentences.en: To accurately tell whether someone is sociable, studies show, we need at least a minute, preferably five.
sentences.cn: 研究表明：要准确辨别某人是否好交际，我们至少需要一分钟，五分钟会更好。

sentences.en: It takes a while to judge complex aspects of personality, like neuroticism or open-mindedness.
sentences.cn: 想要判断某人性格的复杂方面，如神经过敏或思想开明，则需要花上一段时间。

sentences.en: But snap decisions in reaction to rapid stimuli aren't exclusive to the interpersonal realm.
sentences.cn: 但是，因瞬间刺激而做出快速决策并不专属于人际范畴。

sentences.en: Psychologists at the University of Toronto found that viewing a fast-food logo for just a few milliseconds primes us to read 20 percent faster, even though reading has little to do with eating.
sentences.cn: 多伦多大学的心理学家发现，即便阅读和进餐没什么关系，但只看几毫秒的快餐标识就会促使我们将阅读速度加快 20%。

sentences.en: We unconsciously associate fast food with speed and impatience and carry those impulses into whatever else we're doing.
sentences.cn: 我们会不自觉地将快餐与速度和急躁联系起来，并把这些冲动带入我们正在做的任何其他事情中。

sentences.en: Subjects exposed to fast-food flashes also tend to think a musical piece lasts too long.
sentences.cn: 那些看过快餐图像闪现的受试者也倾向于认为一段音乐持续得太久了。

sentences.en: Yet we can reverse such influences.
sentences.cn: 然而，我们可以扭转这些影响。

sentences.en: If we know we will overreact to consumer products or housing options when we see a happy face (one reason good sales representatives and real estate agents are always smiling), we can take a moment before buying.
sentences.cn: 如果我们知道，自己在选择消费品或房屋时看见笑脸会做出过度反应（这是优秀销售代理和不动产代理总是面带笑容的理由之一），就可以在购买之前等一等。

sentences.en: If we know female job screeners are more likely to reject attractive female applicants, we can help screeners understand their biases - or hire outside screeners.
sentences.cn: 如果我们知道，女性招聘官更可能拒绝有魅力的女求职者，就可以帮助招聘官们认识自己的偏见——或是聘请外部招聘官。

sentences.en: John Gottman, the marriage expert, explains that we quickly "thin slice" information reliably only after we ground such snap reactions in "thick sliced" long-term study.
sentences.cn: 婚姻专家约翰·戈特曼解释道，只有在将这种快速反应建立于“厚片”长期研究的基础上之后，我们才能可靠而又快速地汲取“薄片”信息。

sentences.en: When Dr. Gottman really wants to assess whether a couple will stay together, he invites them to his island retreat for a much longer evaluation: two days, not two seconds.
sentences.cn: 当戈特曼博士真想评定夫妻俩是否会共同生活时，他会邀请他们去他岛上的静养处进行更长时间的评估：是两天，而非两秒。

sentences.en: Our ability to mute our hard-wired reactions by pausing is what differentiates us from animals: dogs can think about the future only intermittently or for a few minutes.
sentences.cn: 通过暂停来减缓本能反应的能力使得我们有别于动物：狗只能间歇地或是持续几分钟来思考未来。

sentences.en: But historically we have spent about 12 percent of our days contemplating the longer term.
sentences.cn: 但是，从历史上看来，我们大约花费 12% 的时间来思索更长远的未来。

sentences.en: Although technology might change the way we react, it hasn't changed our nature.
sentences.cn: 尽管科技可能改变我们的反应方式，但它还没有改变我们的天性。

sentences.en: We still have the imaginative capacity to rise above temptation and reverse the high-speed trend.
sentences.cn: 我们仍然具有丰富的想象能力，去超越诱惑、扭转快速趋向。

sentences.en: Europe is not a gender-equality heaven.
sentences.cn: 欧洲并非性别平等的天堂。

sentences.en: In particular, the corporate workplace will never be completely family-friendly until women are part of senior management decisions, and Europe's top corporate-governance positions remain overwhelmingly male.
sentences.cn: 特别是，除非女性能参与高层管理决策，否则职场永远不会完全成为家庭友好型场所，而欧洲的企业管理高层职位仍然是男性占据绝对多数。

sentences.en: Indeed, women hold only 14 per cent of positions on European corporate boards.
sentences.cn: 事实上，女性仅占欧洲企业董事会职位的 14%。

sentences.en: The European Union is now considering legislation to compel corporate boards to maintain a certain proportion of women - up to 60 per cent.
sentences.cn: 欧盟正考虑立法，强迫公司董事会保有一定比例的女性——该比例可高达 60%。

sentences.en: This proposed mandate was born of frustration.
sentences.cn: 此强制性提议源于一次挫折。

sentences.en: Last year, European Commission Vice President Viviane Reding issued a call to voluntary action.
sentences.cn: 去年，欧盟委员会副主席薇薇安·瑞丁发起了一项自愿活动的号召。

sentences.en: Reding invited corporations to sign up for gender balance goals of 40 per cent female board membership.
sentences.cn: 瑞丁邀请各企业参与实现“女性在董事会中占 40%”这一性别平衡目标。

sentences.en: But her appeal was considered a failure: only 24 companies took it up.
sentences.cn: 但她的呼吁被认为是失败的：只有 24 家公司接受其呼吁。

sentences.en: Do we need quotas to ensure that women can continue to climb the corporate ladder fairly as they balance work and family?
sentences.cn: 我们真的需要定额来确保女性在平衡工作和家庭的同时能继续公平地攀爬企业晋升阶梯吗？

sentences.en: "Personally, I don't like quotas," Reding said recently.
sentences.cn: 瑞丁最近表示：“就我个人而言，我不喜欢定额。”

sentences.en: "But I like what the quotas do."
sentences.cn: “但我喜欢定额所起的作用。”

sentences.en: Quotas get action: they "open the way to equality and they break through the glass ceiling," according to Reding, a result seen in France and other countries with legally binding provisions on placing women in top business positions.
sentences.cn: 瑞丁认为，定额能带来行动：它们“为平等开辟了道路，并打破了玻璃天花板”，这一结果已在法国以及其他对女性担任企业高层职位有法律约束性规定的国家中得到印证。

sentences.en: I understand Reding's reluctance - and her frustration.
sentences.cn: 我理解瑞丁的不情愿——还有她的挫败感。

sentences.en: I don't like quotas either; they run counter to my belief in meritocracy, governance by the capable.
sentences.cn: 我也不喜欢定额；它们有悖于我所信仰的英才制度，即能者居之。

sentences.en: But, when one considers the obstacles to achieving the meritocratic ideal, it does look as if a fairer world must be temporarily ordered.
sentences.cn: 但考虑到实现英才制度这一理想所面临的诸多障碍，确实看起来必须暂时实施强制管理才能让世界变得更公平。

sentences.en: After all, four decades of evidence has now shown that corporations in Europe as well as the US are evading the meritocratic hiring and promotion of women to top positions - no matter how much "soft pressure" is put upon them.
sentences.cn: 毕竟，四十年的证据现已表明，不管给它们施加多少“软压力”，欧洲以及美国的企业都在逃避精英选才，拒绝升迁女性到高层。

sentences.en: When women do break through to the summit of corporate power - as, for example, Sheryl Sandberg recently did at Facebook - they attract massive attention precisely because they remain the exception to the rule.
sentences.cn: 当女性确实打入公司权力高层时——例如，就像雪莉·桑德伯格最近在脸书所做的那样——她们会吸引大量关注，而这恰恰是因为她们仍然属于规则中的例外。

sentences.en: If appropriate public policies were in place to help all women - whether CEOs or their children's caregivers - and all families, Sandberg would be no more newsworthy than any other highly capable person living in a more just society.
sentences.cn: 如果能够制定适当的公共政策来帮助所有女性——无论是公司高管还是她们孩子的护工——以及所有家庭，那么在这样一个更公平的社会，桑德伯格就不会比任何其他卓越人士更具报道价值。

sentences.en: What would you do with $590m?
sentences.cn: 你会用 5.9 亿美元做什么？

sentences.en: This is now a question for Gloria MacKenzie, an 84-year-old widow who recently emerged from her small, tin-roofed house in Florida to collect the biggest undivided lottery jackpot in history.
sentences.cn: 这是如今摆在歌莉娅·麦肯齐面前的问题。她是一位 84 岁寡居老人，住在佛罗里达一间狭窄铁皮屋里，最近因独揽史上最高金额彩票头奖并现身领奖而为人所关注。

sentences.en: If she hopes her new-found fortune will yield lasting feelings of fulfilment, she could do worse than read Happy Money by Elizabeth Dunn and Michael Norton.
sentences.cn: 如果她希望这笔新到手的财富能够产生长久满足感，倒不妨读读伊丽莎白·邓恩与迈克·诺顿合著的《快乐金钱》。

sentences.en: These two academics use an array of behavioral research to show that the most rewarding ways to spend money can be counterintuitive.
sentences.cn: 这两位学者运用一系列行为研究表明，最有意义的花钱方式可能是与直觉相反的。

sentences.en: Fantasies of great wealth often involve visions of fancy cars and extravagant homes.
sentences.cn: 对于巨额财富的幻想通常会伴随着对“炫车豪宅”的憧憬。

sentences.en: Yet satisfaction with these material purchases wears off fairly quickly.
sentences.cn: 然而，这些物质购买所带来的满足感会消失得相当快。

sentences.en: What was once exciting and new becomes old-hat; regret creeps in.
sentences.cn: 曾经令人兴奋又新奇的东西变得陈旧过时，懊悔悄然而至。

sentences.en: It is far better to spend money on experiences, say Ms Dunn and Mr Norton, like interesting trips, unique meals or even going to the cinema.
sentences.cn: 邓恩女士和诺顿先生说道，远不如把钱花在“体验”上，比如说有趣的旅行、独特的餐食、甚至是去看电影。

sentences.en: These purchases often become more valuable with time - as stories or memories - particularly if they involve feeling more connected to others.
sentences.cn: 随着时间的流逝，这些体验往往会变得更加珍贵——以记忆或故事的形式——尤其是当它们让人感觉到自己与他人联系更紧密时。

sentences.en: This slim volume is packed with tips to help wage slaves as well as lottery winners get the most "happiness bang for your buck."
sentences.cn: 这本小书满载各种建议，帮助“工薪奴隶”和彩票中奖者们用每一分钱换来最多的快乐。

sentences.en: It seems most people would be better off if they could shorten their commutes to work, spend more time with friends and family and less of it watching television (something the average American spends a whopping two months a year doing, and is hardly jollier for it).
sentences.cn: 似乎大部分人都能通过缩短通勤时间、多陪家人朋友、少看电视（美国人年均竟然有两个月的时间在看电视，却并没有因此更快乐）而过得更好。

sentences.en: Buying gifts or giving to charity is often more pleasurable than purchasing things for oneself, and luxuries are most enjoyable when they are consumed sparingly.
sentences.cn: 给他人买礼物或捐款给慈善机构通常比给自己买东西更令人愉悦，有节制地消费奢侈品才能带来最大快乐。

sentences.en: This is apparently the reason McDonald's restricts the availability of its popular McRib - a marketing trick that has turned the pork sandwich into an object of obsession.
sentences.cn: 显然这正是麦当劳限量供应大受欢迎的烤汁猪排堡的原因所在——这一营销手段已将这种猪肉三明治变成了令人痴迷之物。

sentences.en: Readers of Happy Money are clearly a privileged lot, anxious about fulfilment, not hunger.
sentences.cn: 《快乐金钱》的读者显然属于一个幸运的群体，渴望得到满足感，而不是担心挨饿。

sentences.en: Money may not quite buy happiness, but people in wealthier countries are generally happier than those in poor ones.
sentences.cn: 金钱或许不能真正买到幸福，但富裕国家的人们总体上比贫穷国家的人们更幸福。

sentences.en: Yet the link between feeling good and spending money on others can be seen among rich and poor people around the world, and scarcity enhances the pleasure of most things for most people.
sentences.cn: 然而，全世界范围内，无论穷人还是富人中，都可以看到“将钱用到别人身上”和“感觉愉悦”的联系，且对大部分人来讲，稀缺性提升了大部分事物的愉悦感。

sentences.en: Not everyone will agree with the authors' policy ideas, which range from mandating more holiday time to reducing tax incentives for American homebuyers.
sentences.cn: 并非所有人都会赞同作者从“增加假日时间”到“降低对美国购房者的税收刺激”等政策理念。

sentences.en: But most people will come away from this book believing it was money well spent.
sentences.cn: 但大部分人读完此书后都会认为，它非常值得购买。

sentences.en: An article in Scientific American has pointed out that empirical research says that, actually, you think you're more beautiful than you are.
sentences.cn: 《科学美国人》上的一篇文章指出：实证研究表明，事实上你会把自己想得比实际上漂亮。

sentences.en: We have a deep-seated need to feel good about ourselves and we naturally employ a number of self-enhancing strategies to achieve this.
sentences.cn: 我们有一种根深蒂固的需求，让自我感觉良好，而且自然而然地运用许多自我拉抬策略去达成此目的。

sentences.en: Social psychologists have amassed oceans of research into what they call the "above average effect", or "illusory superiority", and shown that, for example, 70% of us rate ourselves as above average in leadership, 93% in driving and 85% at getting on well with others - all obviously statistical impossibilities.
sentences.cn: 社会心理学家就其所称的“高于均数效应”或“虚幻的优越感”收集了大量的研究，并指出，我们当中有 70% 的人自认为领导力高于常人，93% 的人自认为驾驶能力高于常人，85% 的人自认为与人相处高于常人——而这些显然在统计学上都是不可能的。

sentences.en: We rose-tint our memories and put ourselves into self-affirming situations.
sentences.cn: 我们美化记忆以使自己身处自我肯定状态。

sentences.en: We become defensive when criticised, and apply negative stereotypes to others to boost our own esteem.
sentences.cn: 被批评时我们变得心存戒备，并用消极成见对待他人以增强自己的自尊。

sentences.en: We stalk around thinking we're hot stuff.
sentences.cn: 我们趾高气昂，自认为很有魅力。

sentences.en: Psychologist and behavioural scientist Nicholas Epley oversaw a key study into self-enhancement and attractiveness.
sentences.cn: 心理学家兼行为科学家尼古拉斯·艾普里对一项有关自我拉抬和吸引力的关键研究进行了监督。

sentences.en: Rather than have people simply rate their beauty compared with others, he asked them to identify an original photograph of themselves from a lineup including versions that had been altered to appear more and less attractive.
sentences.cn: 艾普里没有让人们直接将自己的美貌与别人比对，而是让他们从一组被修改过的照片中识别出自己的原始照片，被修改的照片增加或减少了他们的吸引力。

sentences.en: Visual recognition, reads the study, is "an automatic psychological process, occurring rapidly and intuitively with little or no apparent conscious deliberation".
sentences.cn: 该研究显示，视觉识别是“自动心理过程，这一过程依靠直觉快速发生，几乎没有或者没有明显的刻意考虑”。

sentences.en: If the subjects quickly chose a falsely flattering image - which most did - they genuinely believed it was really how they looked.
sentences.cn: 受试者要是迅速选择了一张虚假的美图——大部分受试者都这么选——他们打心底真是觉着这张照片就是他们真实的样子。

sentences.en: Epley found no significant gender difference in responses.
sentences.cn: 艾普里发现，回答中并无明显的性别差异。

sentences.en: Nor was there any evidence that those who self-enhanced the most (that is, the participants who thought the most positively doctored pictures were real) were doing so to make up for profound insecurities.
sentences.cn: 也没有任何证据表明，那些自我拉抬程度最高的人（即那些认为被过度美化的照片是真实的参与者）这样做是为了弥补深层的不安全感。

sentences.en: In fact, those who thought that the images higher up the attractiveness scale were real directly corresponded with those who showed other markers for having higher self-esteem.
sentences.cn: 事实上，那些认为吸引力评分更高的照片是真实的人，恰恰与那些表现出其他高自尊标志的人相吻合。

sentences.en: "I don't think the findings that we have are any evidence of personal delusion," says Epley.
sentences.cn: 艾普里说：“我认为我们的发现根本不能证明个人存在妄想。”

sentences.en: "It's a reflection simply of people generally thinking well of themselves."
sentences.cn: “它仅仅反映了人们普遍自我感觉良好。”

sentences.en: If you are depressed, you won't be self-enhancing.
sentences.cn: 如果你情绪低落，就不会进行自我拉抬。

sentences.en: Knowing the results of Epley's study, it makes sense that many people hate photographs of themselves viscerally - on one level, they don't even recognise the person in the picture as themselves.
sentences.cn: 了解了艾普里的研究结果，就明白许多人为什么打心眼里反感自己的真实照片——在某种程度上，他们甚至没有意识到照片上的人就是自己。

sentences.en: Facebook, therefore, is a self-enhancer's paradise, where people can share only the most flattering photos, the cream of their wit, style, beauty, intellect and lifestyles.
sentences.cn: 因此，Facebook 就成为了自我拉抬者的乐园，用户们可以只在上面分享自己最美的照片以及他们的风趣、风格、美丽、才智和生活方式的精华部分。

sentences.en: It's not that people's profiles are dishonest, says Catalina Toma of Wisconsin-Madison University, "but they portray an idealised version of themselves."
sentences.cn: 威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校的凯特莉娜·托马说，“这并不是说人们在自身形象上不诚实，而是他们为自己绘制了一幅理想画像”。

sentences.en: The concept of man versus machine is at least as old as the industrial revolution, but this phenomenon tends to be most acutely felt during economic downturns and fragile recoveries.
sentences.cn: “人机矛盾”这一概念至少可以上溯到工业革命时期，但这一现象在经济下滑且复苏乏力的情形下给人的感受最为强烈。

sentences.en: And yet, it would be a mistake to think we are right now simply experiencing the painful side of a boom and bust cycle.
sentences.cn: 然而，那种认为“我们现在仅仅是处于繁荣与萧条循环周期的令人痛苦的一面”的想法是个错误。

sentences.en: Certain jobs have gone away for good, outmoded by machines.
sentences.cn: 因使用机器而过时的某些工作已永远地消失了。

sentences.en: Since technology has such an insatiable appetite for eating up human jobs, this phenomenon will continue to restructure our economy in ways we cannot immediately foresee.
sentences.cn: 由于技术在吞噬人类工作方面非常“贪得无厌”，所以这一现象将会继续以难以即时预料的方式重构我们的经济。

sentences.en: When there is rapid improvement in the price and performance of technology, jobs that were once thought to be immune from automation suddenly become threatened.
sentences.cn: 当技术在价格、性能方面大为改善时，那些曾经被认为对自动化免疫的工作也就会突然受到威胁。

sentences.en: This argument has attracted a lot of attention, via the success of the book Race Against the Machine, by Erik Brynjolfsson and Andrew McAfee, who both hail from MIT's Center for Digital Business.
sentences.cn: 这一观点得益于《与机器赛跑》一书的热卖，已获得广泛关注。该书两位作者埃里克·布伦乔尔森与安德鲁·迈克菲均来自麻省理工学院数字化商业中心。

sentences.en: This is a powerful argument, and a scary one.
sentences.cn: 这是个很有说服力，但又让人恐慌的观点。

sentences.en: And yet, John Hagel, author of The Power of Pull and other books, says Brynjolfsson and McAfee miss the reason why these jobs are so vulnerable to technology in the first place.
sentences.cn: 然而，著有《拉动力》和其他书作的约翰·哈格尔认为，布伦乔尔森和迈克菲忽视了这些工作在技术面前不堪一击的根本原因。

sentences.en: Hagel says we have designed jobs in the U.S. that tend to be "tightly scripted" and "highly standardized" ones that leave no room for "individual initiative or creativity".
sentences.cn: 哈格尔说，在美国，我们往往把工作设计成“高度模式化”、“高度标准化”，以至于没给人们留下“发挥个人主动性和创造力”的空间。

sentences.en: In short, these are the types of jobs that machines can perform much better at than human beings.
sentences.cn: 简言之，这些工作属于“机器可以比人类做得好出许多”的类型。

sentences.en: That is how we have put a giant target sign on the backs of American workers, Hagel says.
sentences.cn: 哈格尔说，这就是我们在美国工人背上贴上巨大攻打标靶的方式。

sentences.en: It's time to reinvent the formula for how work is conducted, since we are still relying on a very 20th century notion of work, Hagel says.
sentences.cn: 哈格尔认为，是时候彻底改造我们的工作模式了，因为我们对工作的认知还停留在 20 世纪。

sentences.en: In our rapidly changing economy, we more than ever need people in the workplace who can take initiative and exercise their imagination "to respond to unexpected events".
sentences.cn: 在经济形势迅速转变的今天，我们比以往任何时候都更需要那些在工作中可以发挥主动性、运用想象力“以应付突发事件”的人才。

sentences.en: That is not something machines are good at.
sentences.cn: 那是机器所不擅长的事情。

sentences.en: They are designed to perform very predictable activities.
sentences.cn: 它们被设计为执行非常容易预测的行为。

sentences.en: As Hagel notes, Brynjolfsson and McAfee indeed touched on this point in their book.
sentences.cn: 正如哈格尔所指出的，布伦乔尔森和迈克菲确实在他们书中提到了这一点。

sentences.en: We need to reframe race against the machine as race with the machine.
sentences.cn: 我们需要把“与机器赛跑”的概念转换成“与机器同跑”。

sentences.en: In other words, we need to look at the ways in which machines can augment human labor rather than replace it.
sentences.cn: 换句话说，我们需要去关注机器“增强”人类劳动力的方式，而不是如何“取代”它。

sentences.en: So then the problem is not really about technology, but rather, "how do we innovate our institutions and our work practices?"
sentences.cn: 所以这样看来，问题并非真的在于技术本身，而是在于“我们如何革新我们的体制和工作方式”。

sentences.en: When the government talks about infrastructure contributing to the economy the focus is usually on roads, railways, broadband and energy.
sentences.cn: 当政府谈及有助于经济的基础设施时，通常着眼于公路、铁路、宽带和能源，

sentences.en: Housing is seldom mentioned.
sentences.cn: 却很少提及住房。

sentences.en: Why is that?
sentences.cn: 这是为什么呢？

sentences.en: To some extent the housing sector must shoulder the blame.
sentences.cn: 在某种程度上，房地产行业必须承担责任。

sentences.en: We have not been good at communicating the real value that housing can contribute to economic growth.
sentences.cn: 一直以来我们不是很擅长传达住房对经济发展所贡献的真实价值。

sentences.en: Then there is the scale of the typical housing project.
sentences.cn: 再有一个是典型住房项目的规模。

sentences.en: It is hard to shove for attention among multibillion-pound infrastructure projects, so it is inevitable that the attention is focused elsewhere.
sentences.cn: （它们）很难在数十亿英镑的基础设施项目中获取注意力，因此，注意力集中在他处也在所难免。

sentences.en: But perhaps the most significant reason is that the issue has always been so politically charged.
sentences.cn: 但是也许最重要的原因是，这个问题一直受到严重政治制约。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, the affordable housing situation is desperate.
sentences.cn: 然而，可支付住房形势却很严峻。

sentences.en: Waiting lists increase all the time and we are simply not building enough new homes.
sentences.cn: 一方面，轮候名单一直在增加，另一方面，我们确实没有建造足够多的新房。

sentences.en: The comprehensive spending review offers an opportunity for the government to help rectify this.
sentences.cn: 综合开支审查给政府提供了一个调整这一状况的机会。

sentences.en: It needs to put historical prejudices to one side and take some steps to address our urgent housing need.
sentences.cn: 政府需要将历史偏见搁置一边，采取一些措施来解决我们迫切的住房需求。

sentences.en: There are some indications that it is preparing to do just that.
sentences.cn: 有迹象表明，政府正准备这样做。

sentences.en: The communities minister, Don Foster, has hinted that George Osborne, Chancellor of the Exchequer, may introduce more flexibility to the current cap on the amount that local authorities can borrow against their housing stock debt.
sentences.cn: 社区大臣唐·福斯特已经透露，财政大臣乔治·奥斯本可能对地方政府住房存量债务的借贷数额上限采取更大的灵活度。

sentences.en: Evidence shows that 60,000 extra new homes could be built over the next five years if the cap were lifted, increasing GDP by 0.6%.
sentences.cn: 有证据表明，如果上限被提升，未来 5 年内将有另外 6 万套新房竣工，GDP 将提高 0.6%。

sentences.en: Ministers should also look at creating greater certainty in the rental environment, which would have a significant impact on the ability of registered providers to fund new developments from revenues.
sentences.cn: 部长大臣们还应该考虑提高房屋租赁市场的稳定性，这将对注册供应者凭借营业收入为新建住房提供资金的能力产生重大影响。

sentences.en: But it is not just down to the government.
sentences.cn: 但这不仅仅是政府的责任。

sentences.en: While these measures would be welcome in the short term, we must face up to the fact that the existing £4.5bn programme of grants to fund new affordable housing, set to expire in 2015, is unlikely to be extended beyond then.
sentences.cn: 尽管这些措施在短期内将受到欢迎，但是我们必须面对现实：目前用于投资新的可支付住房的 45 亿英镑拨款项目将于 2015 年到期，并且不可能延期。

sentences.en: The Labour party has recently announced that it will retain a large part of the coalition's spending plans if it returns to power.
sentences.cn: 工党最近宣布，如果重掌大权，它将保留大部分联合政府支出计划。

sentences.en: The housing sector needs to accept that we are very unlikely to ever return to the era of large-scale public grants.
sentences.cn: 房地产行业需要接受的事实是：我们回到大规模公共拨款时代的可能性很低。

sentences.en: We need to adjust to this changing climate.
sentences.cn: 我们需要适应这一变化的环境。

sentences.en: While the government's commitment to long-term funding may have changed, the very pressing need for more affordable housing is real and is not going away.
sentences.cn: 尽管政府对长期资助的承诺可能已经生变，但人们对更多可支付住房的迫切需求是真实存在的，且不会消失。

sentences.en: A new study suggests that contrary to most surveys, people are actually more stressed at home than at work.
sentences.cn: 一项新研究表明，与大多数调查相反，人们实际上在家里比在工作时压力更大。

sentences.en: Researchers measured people's cortisol, which is a stress marker, while they were at work and while they were at home and found it higher at what is supposed to be a place of refuge.
sentences.cn: 研究者对人们在工作和家里时的皮质醇（精神压力的一种标志）进行了检测，结果显示，在人们普遍认为是避风港的环境中，皮质醇的含量更高。

sentences.en: "Further contradicting conventional wisdom, we found that women as well as men have lower levels of stress at work than at home," writes one of the researchers, Sarah Damaske.
sentences.cn: “与普遍看法更加矛盾的是，我们发现女性和男性一样，上班比在家中压力更小。”研究者之一萨拉·达玛斯克写道。

sentences.en: In fact women even say they feel better at work, she notes.
sentences.cn: 她指出，事实上女性甚至说她们上班时感觉更好。

sentences.en: "It is men, not women, who report being happier at home than at work."
sentences.cn: “声称在家中更有幸福感的是男性而非女性。”

sentences.en: Another surprise is that the findings hold true for both those with children and without, but more so for nonparents.
sentences.cn: 另一项令人惊讶的结论是，该发现对有无子女者来说都适用，不过对于无子女者来说更甚。

sentences.en: This is why people who work outside the home have better health.
sentences.cn: 这就解释了为什么在外工作的人更加健康。

sentences.en: What the study doesn't measure is whether people are still doing work when they're at home, whether it is household work or work brought home from the office.
sentences.cn: 这项研究对于“人们回家后是否继续工作，这种工作属于家务还是从办公室带回”并未作出考量。

sentences.en: For many men, the end of the workday is a time to kick back.
sentences.cn: 对于许多男性来说，工作日结束之时便是放松的时刻。

sentences.en: For women who stay home, they never get to leave the office.
sentences.cn: 对家中的女性来说，她们却没有“离开办公室”的机会。

sentences.en: And for women who work outside the home, they often are playing catch-up-with-household tasks.
sentences.cn: 对在外工作的女性而言，她们常常回家后还要赶着完成家务活儿。

sentences.en: With the blurring of roles, and the fact that the home front lags well behind the workplace in making adjustments for working women, it's not surprising that women are more stressed at home.
sentences.cn: 由于角色的模糊，以及职业女性在家庭大后方比在职场中更难作出自我调整这一事实，女性在家中压力更大也就不足为奇了。

sentences.en: But it's not just a gender thing.
sentences.cn: 但这不仅仅是性别的问题。

sentences.en: At work, people pretty much know what they're supposed to be doing: working, making money, doing the tasks they have to do in order to draw an income.
sentences.cn: 工作中，人们更清楚他们应该做什么：干活、赚钱、完成硬性任务从而获得收入。

sentences.en: The bargain is very pure: Employee puts in hours of physical or mental labor and employee draws out life-sustaining moola.
sentences.cn: 这种协议很纯粹：员工投入数小时体力和脑力劳动，取得维持生计的钱。

sentences.en: On the home front, however, people have no such clarity.
sentences.cn: 然而，在家庭大后方，情况没有这么明确。

sentences.en: Rare is the household in which the division of labor is so clinically and methodically laid out.
sentences.cn: 很少有家庭能不偏不倚且有序地安排家务活儿。

sentences.en: There are a lot of tasks to be done, there are inadequate rewards for most of them.
sentences.cn: 有许多家务事要做，大部分人却得不到足够的奖励。

sentences.en: Your home colleagues - your family - have no clear rewards for their labor; they need to be talked into it, or if they're teenagers, threatened with complete removal of all electronic devices.
sentences.cn: 你的家庭同事——你的家人——对家务劳动没有明确的奖励；他们需要被劝服去做家务，或者如果他们是青少年的话，需要以“切断一切电子设备”为威胁让他们完成家务。

sentences.en: Plus, they're your family.
sentences.cn: 而且，他们是家人。

sentences.en: You cannot fire your family.
sentences.cn: 你不可能解雇自己的家人。

sentences.en: You never really get to go home from home.
sentences.cn: 你永远不会真正地从家务劳动中解放出来。

sentences.en: So it's not surprising that people are more stressed at home.
sentences.cn: 因此人们在家中压力更大不足为奇。

sentences.en: Not only are the tasks apparently infinite, the co-workers are much harder to motivate.
sentences.cn: 这不仅仅是由于任务似乎没完没了，还由于激发“同事”的积极性要困难得多。

sentences.en: For years, studies have found that first-generation college students - those who do not have a parent with a college degree - lag other students on a range of education achievement factors.
sentences.cn: 多年来的研究已发现，第一代大学生——那些父母均没有大学学位的大学生——在一系列学业成就指标上均落后于其他学生。

sentences.en: Their grades are lower and their dropout rates are higher.
sentences.cn: 他们考试分数更低，辍学率更高。

sentences.en: But since such students are most likely to advance economically if they succeed in higher education, colleges and universities have pushed for decades to recruit more of them.
sentences.cn: 但由于这类学生一旦成功完成高等教育，便会是最有可能在经济上取得发展的人群，所以各高校数十年来一直在努力招收更多这类学生。

sentences.en: This has created "a paradox" in that recruiting first-generation students, but then watching many of them fail, means that higher education has "continued to reproduce and widen, rather than close" an achievement gap based on social class, according to the depressing beginning of a paper forthcoming in the journal Psychological Science.
sentences.cn: 这就产生了“一种自相矛盾的情形”：高校把第一代大学生招进来，然后却任由他们中许多人走向失败，这意味着高等教育在“继续再生并扩大，而非弥合”基于社会阶层的成就差距，一篇即将发表在《心理科学》上的文章令人沮丧的开头部分如此写道。

sentences.en: But the article is actually quite optimistic, as it outlines a potential solution to this problem, suggesting that an approach (which involves a one-hour, next-to-no-cost program) can close 63 percent of the achievement gap (measured by such factors as grades) between first-generation and other students.
sentences.cn: 但这篇文章实际上相当乐观，因为它概述了解决这个问题的一种可能方案，指出有一种方式（一个一小时、几乎零成本的项目）能够将第一代大学生与其他学生之间的成就差距缩小 63%（以成绩等指标衡量）。

sentences.en: The authors of the paper are from different universities, and their findings are based on a study involving 147 students (who completed the project) at an unnamed private university.
sentences.cn: 这篇论文的作者们来自不同的大学，其发现是基于对一所匿名私立大学的 147 名学生的调查（这些学生均完成了该项目）。

sentences.en: First generation was defined as not having a parent with a four-year college degree.
sentences.cn: “第一代大学生”被定义为父母均无四年制大学学历的学生。

sentences.en: Most of the first-generation students (59.1 percent) were recipients of Pell Grants, a federal grant for undergraduates with financial need, while this was true only for 8.6 percent of the students with at least one parent with a four-year degree.
sentences.cn: 大多数“第一代大学生”（59.1%）是佩尔助学金（一项为有经济需求的本科生设立的联邦奖学金）的受助对象，而那些父母至少一人有本科学历的学生中，这一比例仅为 8.6%。

sentences.en: Their thesis - that a relatively modest intervention could have a big impact - was based on the view that first-generation students may be most lacking not in potential but in practical knowledge about how to deal with the issues that face most college students.
sentences.cn: 他们的论题——较小的干预便能产生很大的影响——是基于这样一种观点：第一代大学生最欠缺的可能并不是潜力，而是关于“如何应对摆在大多数高校学生面前的各种问题”的实用知识。

sentences.en: They cite past research by several authors to show that this is the gap that must be narrowed to close the achievement gap.
sentences.cn: 他们引用了数位作者的已有研究说明，这正是弥合成就差距所必须缩小的缺口。

sentences.en: Many first-generation students "struggle to navigate the middle-class culture of higher education, learn the 'rules of the game,' and take advantage of college resources," they write.
sentences.cn: 许多第一代大学生“挣扎于应付高等教育中的中产阶级文化，学会‘游戏规则’并利用高校资源”，他们写道。

sentences.en: And this becomes more of a problem when colleges don't talk about the class advantages and disadvantages of different groups of students.
sentences.cn: 当大学对于不同学生群体的阶层优势和劣势避而不谈时，这就会越发成为问题。

sentences.en: "Because US colleges and universities seldom acknowledge how social class can affect students' educational experiences, many first-generation students lack insight about why they are struggling and do not understand how students 'like them' can improve."
sentences.cn: “由于美国高校很少承认社会阶层能够影响学生的教育体验，所以很多第一代大学生不明白他们为何挣扎，也不知道‘像他们一样的’学生如何才能进步。”

sentences.en: Even in traditional offices, "the lingua franca of corporate America has gotten much more emotional and much more right-brained than it was 20 years ago," said Harvard Business School professor Nancy Koehn.
sentences.cn: 即使在传统办公室里，“美国企业的通用语也比二十年前更富情感，更多由右脑主导，”哈佛大学商学院教授南希·克恩如是说。

sentences.en: She started spinning off examples.
sentences.cn: 她随即列举一系列实例。

sentences.en: "If you and I parachuted back to Fortune 500 companies in 1990, we would see much less frequent use of terms like journey, mission, passion.
sentences.cn: “如果我们穿越回到 1990 年的世界五百强企业中，我们会发现像‘旅程’、‘使命’、‘激情’这样的词汇较少使用。

sentences.en: There were goals, there were strategies, there were objectives, but we didn't talk about energy; we didn't talk about passion."
sentences.cn: 我们会使用‘目标’、‘策略’、‘目的’这样的词汇，但却不会谈及‘干劲’；也不会谈及‘激情’。”

sentences.en: Koehn pointed out that this new era of corporate vocabulary is very "team"-oriented - and not by coincidence.
sentences.cn: 克恩指出新时代的这种企业词汇具有明显的“团队”导向——而这并非偶然。

sentences.en: "Let's not forget sports - in male-dominated corporate America, it's still a big deal.
sentences.cn: “别忘了体育运动——在男性主导的美国企业中，它依然非同小可。

sentences.en: It's not explicitly conscious; it's the idea that I'm a coach, and you're my team, and we're in this together.
sentences.cn: 它不是明明白白的有意行为；它是这样一种想法：我是教练，你们是我的队员，我们同舟共济。

sentences.en: There are lots and lots of CEOs in very different companies, but most think of themselves as coaches and this is their team and they want to win."
sentences.cn: 企业各不相同，CEO 许许多多，但大部分都自认为是教练，企业是自己的团队，他们想赢。”

sentences.en: These terms are also intended to infuse work with meaning - and, as Rakesh Khurana, another professor, points out, increase allegiance to the firm.
sentences.cn: 这些词汇的使用也旨在赋予工作意义——同时，如另一位教授拉凯什·库拉纳指出的那样，提高员工对企业的忠诚度。

sentences.en: "You have the importation of terminology that historically used to be associated with non-profit organizations and religious organizations: terms like vision, values, passion, and purpose," said Khurana.
sentences.cn: 库拉纳说，“我们引入了历史上和非营利性组织及宗教组织相关联的专门用语，如‘愿景’、‘价值观’、‘激情’和‘目标’。”

sentences.en: This new focus on personal fulfillment can help keep employees motivated amid increasingly loud debates over work-life balance.
sentences.cn: 在关于“如何平衡工作和生活”的越来越激烈的辩论中，这种新兴的对个人自我实现的关注有助于激励员工。

sentences.en: The "mommy wars" of the 1990s are still going on today, prompting arguments about why women still can't have it all and books like Sheryl Sandberg's Lean In, whose title has become a buzzword in its own right.
sentences.cn: 二十世纪九十年代的“妈咪大战”如今仍在继续，激起了关于“为何女性仍然不能兼顾工作与家庭”的争论，还催生了如谢丽尔·桑德伯格的《向前一步》一类的书籍，这一书名本身也因此成为流行语。

sentences.en: Terms like unplug, offline, life-hack, bandwidth, and capacity are all about setting boundaries between the office and the home.
sentences.cn: 像“断电”、“离线”、“生活窍门”、“带宽”和“容量”这样的词汇都和划清工作和家庭的界限有关。

sentences.en: But if your work is your "passion," you'll be more likely to devote yourself to it, even if that means going home for dinner and then working long after the kids are in bed.
sentences.cn: 但是如果你的工作就是你的“激情”（所在），即使这意味着你需要回家吃晚饭、然后等孩子入睡后还要继续工作很长时间，你也更愿意投入其中。

sentences.en: But this seems to be the irony of office speak: Everyone makes fun of it, but managers love it, companies depend on it, and regular people willingly absorb it.
sentences.cn: 但这似乎是关于办公室语言的一个讽刺：大家都拿它开玩笑，但是经理们却喜欢它，公司依赖于它，普通人欣然接受它。

sentences.en: As a linguist once said, "You can get people to think it's nonsense at the same time that you buy into it."
sentences.cn: 正如一位语言学家所说，“你可以让其他人认为它是无稽之谈，但与此同时你却买它的账。”

sentences.en: In a workplace that's fundamentally indifferent to your life and its meaning, office speak can help you figure out how you relate to your work - and how your work defines who you are.
sentences.cn: 在一个根本与你生活及生活的意义毫不相关的职场中，办公室语言能帮你认清你和工作的关系——以及你的工作如何定义你是谁。

sentences.en: Many people talked of the 288,000 new jobs the Labor Department reported for June, along with the drop in the unemployment rate to 6.1 percent, as good news.
sentences.cn: 许多人将劳工部六月所公布的 28.8 万个新增就业岗位以及失业率降至 6.1% 视为福音大加谈论。

sentences.en: And they were right.
sentences.cn: 而且他们是对的。

sentences.en: For now it appears the economy is creating jobs at a decent pace.
sentences.cn: 目前看来经济似乎正在以相当不错的速度创造着就业机会。

sentences.en: We still have a long way to go to get back to full employment, but at least we are now finally moving forward at a faster pace.
sentences.cn: 虽然重回充分就业还有很长的路要走，但至少我们现在终于能以较快的速度前行了。

sentences.en: However, there is another important part of the jobs picture that was largely overlooked.
sentences.cn: 然而，人们在很大程度上忽略了就业图景的另一重要部分。

sentences.en: There was a big jump in the number of people who report voluntarily working part-time.
sentences.cn: 申报自愿从事兼职工作的人数出现大幅激增。

sentences.en: This figure is now 830,000 (4.4 percent) above its year ago level.
sentences.cn: 该数字目前比一年前的水平高出 83 万（4.4%）。

sentences.en: Before explaining the connection to the Obamacare, it is worth making an important distinction.
sentences.cn: 在解释与奥巴马医改的关联之前，值得做一个重要的区分。

sentences.en: Many people who work part-time jobs actually want full-time jobs.
sentences.cn: 许多从事兼职工作的人实际上想要全职工作。

sentences.en: They take part-time work because this is all they can get.
sentences.cn: 他们从事兼职工作是因为这是他们所能得到的全部。

sentences.en: An increase in involuntary part-time work is evidence of weakness in the labor market and it means that many people will be having a very hard time making ends meet.
sentences.cn: 非自愿兼职工作的增加是劳动力市场疲软的证据，这意味着许多人将很难维持收支平衡。

sentences.en: There was an increase in involuntary part-time in June, but the general direction has been down.
sentences.cn: 六月份非自愿兼职有所增加，但总体呈下降趋势。

sentences.en: Involuntary part-time employment is still far higher than before the recession, but it is down by 640,000 (7.9 percent) from its year ago level.
sentences.cn: 非自愿兼职者虽仍比经济衰退之前高出许多，但比一年前水平降低了 64 万（7.9%）。

sentences.en: We know the difference between voluntary and involuntary part-time employment because people tell us.
sentences.cn: 我们之所以能区分自愿与非自愿兼职，是因为人们告诉了我们。

sentences.en: The survey used by the Labor Department asks people if they worked less than 35 hours in the reference week.
sentences.cn: 劳工部采用的调查会询问人们，调查参考周内的工作时间是否少于 35 小时。

sentences.en: If the answer is "yes," they are classified as working part-time.
sentences.cn: 如果回答“是”，他们就会被归类为从事兼职工作。

sentences.en: The survey then asks whether they worked less than 35 hours in that week because they wanted to work less than full time or because they had no choice.
sentences.cn: 该调查会进一步询问，他们那周的工作时间少于 35 小时是因为自己希望工作时间少于全职还是因为别无选择。

sentences.en: They are only classified as voluntary part-time workers if they tell the survey taker they chose to work less than 35 hours a week.
sentences.cn: 只有在他们告诉调查者他们“选择”一周工作少于 35 小时的情况下，才会被归类为自愿兼职工作者。

sentences.en: The issue of voluntary part-time relates to Obamacare because one of the main purposes was to allow people to get insurance outside of employment.
sentences.cn: 自愿兼职工作问题的确和奥巴马医改相关，因为医改的主要目的之一便是使人们在非就业的情况下也能得到保险。

sentences.en: For many people, especially those with serious health conditions or family members with serious health conditions, before Obamacare the only way to get insurance was through a job that provided health insurance.
sentences.cn: 对于很多人，尤其是那些本人或家人有严重健康问题的人来说，在奥巴马医改之前，他们得到保险的唯一途径便是找到一份提供医疗保险的工作。

sentences.en: However, Obamacare has allowed more than 12 million people to either get insurance through Medicaid or the exchanges.
sentences.cn: 然而，奥巴马医改使得 1200 多万人能够通过医疗补助计划或医保交易所获得保险。

sentences.en: These are people who may previously have felt the need to get a full-time job that provided insurance in order to cover themselves and their families.
sentences.cn: 这些人此前可能感到迫切需要找到一份提供保险的全职工作，以便为自己和家人提供保障。

sentences.en: With Obamacare there is no longer a link between employment and insurance.
sentences.cn: 有了奥巴马医改，就业和保险之间不再有关联。

sentences.en: It's true that high-school coding classes aren't essential for learning computer science in college.
sentences.cn: 诚然，高中编码课程对于大学计算机科学的学习并非必不可少。

sentences.en: Students without experience can catch up after a few introductory courses, said Tom Cortina, the assistant dean at Carnegie Mellon's School of Computer Science.
sentences.cn: 没有经验的学生在几节入门课程之后便可以赶上，卡内基梅隆大学计算机科学学院的副院长汤姆·科尔蒂纳说道。

sentences.en: However, Cortina said, early exposure is beneficial.
sentences.cn: 然而，科尔蒂纳说，早点接触（编码课程）是有益的。

sentences.en: When younger kids learn computer science, they learn that it's not just a confusing, endless string of letters and numbers - but a tool to build apps, or create artwork, or test hypotheses.
sentences.cn: 年龄较小的孩子学习计算机科学时，他们认识到它并非只是令人困惑的、无休止的字母与数字组成的字符串——也是构建应用程序、创造艺术作品、检验假设的工具。

sentences.en: It's not as hard for them to transform their thought processes as it is for older students.
sentences.cn: 对于他们来说，转换思维过程不会像年龄较大的学生（转换思维过程）那样难。

sentences.en: Breaking down problems into bite-sized chunks and using code to solve them becomes normal.
sentences.cn: 把问题分解成小块然后使用编码解决问题变得稀松平常。

sentences.en: Giving more children this training could increase the number of people interested in the field and help fill the jobs gap, Cortina said.
sentences.cn: 给予更多的孩子这样的培训会增加对这一领域感兴趣者的人数，从而有助于填补职位缺口，科尔蒂纳说道。

sentences.en: Students also benefit from learning something about coding before they get to college, where introductory computer-science classes are packed to the brim, which can drive the less-experienced or -determined students away.
sentences.cn: 学生在进入大学之前也会从学习一些有关编码的知识中获益，因为在大学里，计算机科学入门课程都排得满满当当，这可能会吓跑那些经验欠缺或意志力不足的学生。

sentences.en: The Flatiron School, where people pay to learn programming, started as one of the many coding bootcamps that's become popular for adults looking for a career change.
sentences.cn: 熨斗学校，人们花钱来学习编程的地方，创办之初只是众多编码训练营之中的一家，现如今已在那些寻求职业转变的成人中大受欢迎。

sentences.en: The high-schoolers get the same curriculum, but "we try to gear lessons toward things they're interested in," said Victoria Friedman, an instructor.
sentences.cn: 高中生上相同的课程，但是“我们在努力根据他们的兴趣来调整课程，”一位名叫维多利亚·弗里德曼的讲师说道。

sentences.en: For instance, one of the apps the students are developing suggests movies based on your mood.
sentences.cn: 例如，学生们正在开发的应用之一就是基于你的心情来推荐电影。

sentences.en: The students in the Flatiron class probably won't drop out of high school and build the next Facebook.
sentences.cn: 熨斗课堂的学生很可能不会从高中辍学，去创建下一个 Facebook。

sentences.en: Programming languages have a quick turnover, so the "Ruby on Rails" language they learned may not even be relevant by the time they enter the job market.
sentences.cn: 编程语言更新换代很快，因此他们所学的“Ruby on Rails”语言在他们进入就业市场时可能就已经完全脱节了。

sentences.en: But the skills they learn - how to think logically through a problem and organize the results - apply to any coding language, said Deborah Seehorn, an education consultant for the state of North Carolina.
sentences.cn: 但是他们学到的技能——如何有逻辑地充分思考某问题并整理结果——适用于任何一种编码语言，南卡罗来纳州的一名教育顾问黛博拉·希霍恩说道。

sentences.en: Indeed, the Flatiron students might not go into IT at all.
sentences.cn: 实际上，熨斗学校的学生可能根本不会从事 IT 行业。

sentences.en: But creating a future army of coders is not the sole purpose of the classes.
sentences.cn: 但是创建一支未来程序员队伍并不是这些课程的唯一目的。

sentences.en: These kids are going to be surrounded by computers - in their pockets, in their offices, in their homes - for the rest of their lives.
sentences.cn: 这些孩子未来的岁月将会被电脑包围——口袋中有电脑、办公室有电脑、家里有电脑。

sentences.en: The younger they learn how computers think, how to coax the machine into producing what they want - the earlier they learn that they have the power to do that - the better.
sentences.cn: 他们越早学习电脑如何思维，如何劝诱这一机器去制作自己需要的东西——他们越早了解到自己具备这种能力——对他们也越好。

sentences.en: Biologists estimate that as many as 2 million lesser prairie chickens - a kind of bird living on stretching grasslands - once lent red to the often grey landscape of the midwestern and southwestern United States.
sentences.cn: 生物学家估计，多达 200 万只的小草原榛鸡——一种栖息于绵延草地的鸟类——曾为美国中西部和西南部常年灰暗的风景增添了一抹红色。

sentences.en: But just some 22,000 birds remain today, occupying about 16% of the species' historic range.
sentences.cn: 但如今仅剩下约 2.2 万只，栖息地约为该物种历史分布范围的 16%。

sentences.en: The crash was a major reason the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (USFWS) decided to formally list the bird as threatened.
sentences.cn: 这种急剧下降是美国鱼类及野生动物管理局（USFWS）决定正式将该鸟类列为受威胁物种的一个主要原因。

sentences.en: "The lesser prairie chicken is in a desperate situation," said USFWS Director Daniel Ashe.
sentences.cn: “小草原榛鸡处于危急状态，”USFWS 局长丹尼尔·阿什说道。

sentences.en: Some environmentalists, however, were disappointed.
sentences.cn: 然而一些环保主义者对此决定感到失望。

sentences.en: They had pushed the agency to designate the bird as "endangered," a status that gives federal officials greater regulatory power to crack down on threats.
sentences.cn: 他们曾敦促该机构将这一鸟类认定为“濒危物种”，这一定位会给予联邦官员更大的监管权力，以打击对该物种的威胁。

sentences.en: But Ashe and others argued that the "threatened" tag gave the federal government flexibility to try out new, potentially less confrontational conservation approaches.
sentences.cn: 但是阿什及其他人士坚称，“受威胁物种”标签给了联邦政府尝试“新的、潜在对抗性较低的保护方法”的灵活性。

sentences.en: In particular, they called for forging closer collaborations with western state governments, which are often uneasy with federal action, and with the private landowners who control an estimated 95% of the prairie chicken's habitat.
sentences.cn: 特别是，他们呼吁与西部各州政府（通常不满联邦政府的行动）以及私人土地所有者（控制着约 95% 的草原榛鸡栖息地）缔造更紧密的合作关系。

sentences.en: Under the plan, for example, the agency said it would not prosecute landowners or businesses that unintentionally kill, harm, or disturb the bird, as long as they had signed a range-wide management plan to restore prairie chicken habitat.
sentences.cn: 例如，根据该计划，只要土地所有者或企业签署了一份旨在恢复草原榛鸡栖息地的全域管理计划，该机构就不会对那些无意中杀死、伤害或惊扰该鸟类的土地所有者或企业提起诉讼。

sentences.en: Negotiated by USFWS and the states, the plan requires individuals and businesses that damage habitat as part of their operations to pay into a fund to replace every acre destroyed with 2 new acres of suitable habitat.
sentences.cn: 该计划由 USFWS 与各州协商制定，要求那些在其经营活动中破坏栖息地的个人和企业向一项基金付款，以便每破坏一英亩栖息地就用两英亩新的适宜栖息地加以补偿。

sentences.en: The fund will also be used to compensate landowners who set aside habitat.
sentences.cn: 该基金还将用于补偿那些留出栖息地的土地所有者。

sentences.en: USFWS also set an interim goal of restoring prairie chicken populations to an annual average of 67,000 birds over the next 10 years.
sentences.cn: USFWS 还设定了一个阶段性目标，即在未来 10 年内将草原榛鸡的种群数量恢复到年均 6.7 万只。

sentences.en: And it gives the Western Association of Fish and Wildlife Agencies (WAFWA), a coalition of state agencies, the job of monitoring progress.
sentences.cn: 它还把监测进展的工作交给了西部鱼类及野生动物机构协会（WAFWA）——一个由各州机构组成的联盟。

sentences.en: Overall, the idea is to let "states remain in the driver's seat for managing the species," Ashe said.
sentences.cn: 阿什说，总体而言，其理念是让“各州在管理该物种方面继续处于主导地位”。

sentences.en: Not everyone buys the win-win rhetoric.
sentences.cn: 不是每个人都接受这种双赢说辞。

sentences.en: Some Congress members are trying to block the plan, and at least a dozen industry groups, four states, and three environmental groups are challenging it in federal court.
sentences.cn: 一些国会议员正试图阻挠该计划的实施，且至少有十几个行业团体、四个州以及三个环境保护组织正在联邦法庭上对其发起质疑。

sentences.en: Not surprisingly, industry groups and states generally argue it goes too far; environmentalists say it doesn't go far enough.
sentences.cn: 行业团体和各州普遍认为它做得太过，而环保主义者表示它做得还不够，这并不令人意外。

sentences.en: "The federal government is giving responsibility for managing the bird to the same industries that are pushing it to extinction," says biologist Jay Lininger.
sentences.cn: “联邦政府正将对该鸟类的管理责任交给恰恰是正在将其推向灭绝的行业，”生物学家杰伊·林恩格说道。

sentences.en: That everyone's too busy these days is a cliche.
sentences.cn: 现在人人都太忙，这是老生常谈。

sentences.en: But one specific complaint is made especially mournfully: There's never any time to read.
sentences.cn: 但是，一个具体而又极其悲哀的抱怨是：根本没时间阅读。

sentences.en: What makes the problem thornier is that the usual time-management techniques don't seem sufficient.
sentences.cn: 使这一问题更加棘手的是，那些常规的时间管理技巧似乎并不奏效。

sentences.en: The web's full of articles offering tips on making time to read: "Give up TV" or "Carry a book with you at all times."
sentences.cn: 网上有很多介绍“腾出时间阅读”小窍门的文章，比如“不看电视”、“身边随时带一本书”。

sentences.en: But in my experience, using such methods to free up the odd 30 minutes doesn't work.
sentences.cn: 但根据我的经验，采用这些窍门挤出个 30 来分钟并没什么用。

sentences.en: Sit down to read and the flywheel of work-related thoughts keeps spinning - or else you're so exhausted that a challenging book's the last thing you need.
sentences.cn: 坐下来认真阅读却发现与工作相关的思绪飞轮始终转个不停——要不就是极度疲惫，以至于阅读一本有挑战的书成为你最不想去做的事。

sentences.en: The modern mind, Tim Parks, a novelist and critic, writes, "is overwhelmingly inclined toward communication... It is not simply that one is interrupted; it is that one is actually inclined to interruption."
sentences.cn: 小说家兼评论家蒂姆·帕克斯写道：现代人的大脑“非常愿意交流……不是被打断这么简单，而是人们真的愿意中断。”

sentences.en: Deep reading requires not just time, but a special kind of time which can't be obtained merely by becoming more efficient.
sentences.cn: 深度阅读需要的不只是时间，而是一种特殊的时间，这种时间仅仅靠提高效率是无法得到的。

sentences.en: In fact, "becoming more efficient" is part of the problem.
sentences.cn: 事实上，“变得更加高效”是问题的一部分。

sentences.en: Thinking of time as a resource to be maximised means you approach it instrumentally, judging any given moment as well spent only in so far as it advances progress toward some goal.
sentences.cn: 把时间看作一种要最大限度利用的资源意味着你功利性地对待时间：认为每一刻都应该充分利用起来以使其向着某一既定目标迈进。

sentences.en: Immersive reading, by contrast, depends on being willing to risk inefficiency, goallessness, even time-wasting.
sentences.cn: 相形之下，沉浸式阅读需要人们愿意承担低效率、无目标、甚至浪费时间的风险。

sentences.en: Try to slot it in as a to-do list item and you'll manage only goal-focused reading - useful, sometimes, but not the most fulfilling kind.
sentences.cn: 将之放在任务清单里只能进行目标集中式阅读——有时候有用，但是并非是最令人满足的阅读方式。

sentences.en: "The future comes at us like empty bottles along an unstoppable and nearly infinite conveyor belt," writes Gary Eberle in his book Sacred Time, and "we feel a pressure to fill these different-sized bottles (days, hours, minutes) as they pass, for if they get by without being filled, we will have wasted them."
sentences.cn: “未来就像永不停歇、永无止境传送带上的空瓶子一样向我们走来”，盖里·埃伯利在他《神圣的时间》一书中写道：“随着时间的流逝，我们要把这些不同大小的瓶子（天，小时，分钟）装满，对此我们倍感压力，因为如果它们没有被装满就过去了的话，我们就是浪费了时间。”

sentences.en: No mind-set could be worse for losing yourself in a book.
sentences.cn: 没有什么思维模式比这种思维模式更不利于沉浸在书本中了。

sentences.en: So what does work? Perhaps surprisingly, scheduling regular times for reading.
sentences.cn: 那什么才起作用呢？安排固定时间阅读，这也许出人意料。

sentences.en: You'd think this might fuel the efficiency mind-set, but in fact, Eberle notes, such ritualistic behaviour helps us "step outside time's flow" into "soul time."
sentences.cn: 你或许认为这可能会加剧“效率至上”的思维倾向，但实际上，埃伯利指出，这种例行行为帮助我们“从时间的流逝中走出来”，进入“灵魂时间”。

sentences.en: You could limit distractions by reading only physical books, or on single-purpose e-readers.
sentences.cn: 你可以通过只阅读纸质书或在只有单一功能的电子阅读器上阅读来减少干扰。

sentences.en: "Carry a book with you at all times" can actually work, too - providing you dip in often enough, so that reading becomes the default state from which you temporarily surface to take care of business, before dropping back down.
sentences.cn: “随时随身携带一本书”其实也可行——如果你能够频繁地沉入其中，这样阅读就成了你的默认状态，从中你可以暂时脱离开来处理工作，然后再沉浸进去。

sentences.en: On a really good day, it no longer feels as if you're "making time to read," but just reading, and making time for everything else.
sentences.cn: 在一个着实美好的日子里，你不会再感觉像是在“挤时间阅读”，而是仅仅在阅读，并且是要挤时间去做其他事。

sentences.en: Against a backdrop of drastic changes in economy and population structure, younger Americans are drawing a new 21st-century road map to success, a latest poll has found.
sentences.cn: 最新民意调查发现：在经济、人口结构急剧改变的背景下，较为年轻的美国人正在绘制一幅新型的 21 世纪成功路线图。

sentences.en: Across generational lines, Americans continue to prize many of the same traditional milestones of a successful life, including getting married, having children, owning a home, and retiring in their sixties.
sentences.cn: 跨越代际线，美国人依然高度重视许多相同的、传统的成功人生标志性事件，包括结婚、生子、购房及六十多岁退休。

sentences.en: But while young and old mostly agree on what constitutes the finish line of a fulfilling life, they offer strikingly different paths for reaching it.
sentences.cn: 但是，尽管年轻一辈和老一辈在“什么构成成功人生的终点线”上大体达成共识，他们却提供了截然不同的到达终点线的路径。

sentences.en: Young people who are still getting started in life were more likely than older adults to prioritize personal fulfillment in their work, to believe they will advance their careers most by regularly changing jobs, to favor communities with more public services and a faster pace of life, to agree that couples should be financially secure before getting married or having children, and to maintain that children are best served by two parents working outside the home, the survey found.
sentences.cn: 调查发现：相比稍微年长一些的成年人来讲，仍处于人生起步阶段的年轻人更可能在工作中优先考虑个人成就感，他们觉得频繁更换工作最能推动职业发展，他们更喜欢公共服务更多、生活节奏更快的社区，他们赞同伴侣在结婚生子前应该有经济保障，并认为孩子最好由均在外工作的双亲来抚育。

sentences.en: From career to community and family, these contrasts suggest that in the aftermath of the searing Great Recession, those just starting out in life are defining priorities and expectations that will increasingly spread through virtually all aspects of American life, from consumer preferences to housing patterns to politics.
sentences.cn: 从职业发展到社区、家庭，这些差异表明：在灼热的大衰退余波下，那些人生刚刚起步的人正在界定首要事项和期望，这些事项和期望将逐渐蔓延到美国人生活的几乎所有方面，从消费者偏好到居住模式，再到政治。

sentences.en: Young and old converge on one key point: Overwhelming majorities of both groups said they believe it is harder for young people today to get started in life than it was for earlier generations.
sentences.cn: 年轻一辈和老一辈在一个关键点上观点趋向一致：双方以压倒性多数认为当今年轻人比前几代人更难起步。

sentences.en: While younger people are somewhat more optimistic than their elders about the prospects for those starting out today, big majorities in both groups believe those "just getting started in life" face a tougher climb than earlier generations in reaching such signpost achievements as securing a good-paying job, starting a family, managing debt, and finding affordable housing.
sentences.cn: 尽管年轻人要比年长者对今天刚起步的年轻人的前景多少乐观一点，但是双方绝大多数认为，在实现诸如获取高薪的工作、组建家庭、债务管理、拥有买得起的住房这些标志性成就上，那些“刚起步”的人比前几代人面临更艰难的攀行。

sentences.en: Pete Schneider considers the climb tougher today.
sentences.cn: 皮特·施耐德认为现如今的攀行更艰难。

sentences.en: Schneider, a 27-year-old auto technician from the Chicago suburbs, says he struggled to find a job after graduating from college.
sentences.cn: 施耐德，一位来自芝加哥郊区的 27 岁汽车技师，说大学毕业后很努力才找到一份工作。

sentences.en: Even now that he is working steadily, he said, "I can't afford to pay my monthly mortgage payments on my own, so I have to rent rooms out to people to make that happen."
sentences.cn: 尽管工作稳定，但是“凭一己之力无法负担月供，因此不得不把房间租给别人以负担月供，”他说。

sentences.en: Looking back, he is struck that his parents could provide a comfortable life for their children even though neither had completed college when he was young.
sentences.cn: 回首过往，他猛然发现，小时候父母尽管都没有读大学，却也能为孩子们提供一个舒适的生活。

sentences.en: "I still grew up in an upper middle-class home with parents who didn't have college degrees," Schneider said. "I don't think people are capable of that anymore."
sentences.cn: “尽管爸妈没有大学文凭，但是我仍然在一个上层中产阶级家庭中长大，”施耐德说，“我想人们再也做不到那样了。”

sentences.en: Every Saturday morning, at 9 am, more than 50,000 runners set off to run 5km around their local park.
sentences.cn: 每周六上午 9 点，超过 5 万名跑步者开始绕当地公园跑 5 千米。

sentences.en: The Parkrun phenomenon began with a dozen friends and has inspired 400 events in the UK and more abroad.
sentences.cn: “公园跑”现象始于十来个朋友，如今已在英国激起 400 场活动，国外更多。

sentences.en: Events are free, staffed by thousands of volunteers.
sentences.cn: 活动免费，工作人员由数千名志愿者担任。

sentences.en: Runners range from four years old to grandparents; their times range from Andrew Baddeley's world record 13 minutes 48 seconds up to an hour.
sentences.cn: 跑步者年龄下起 4 岁的幼童，上至祖父母之辈；他们的成绩最短的是安德鲁·巴德利 13 分 48 秒的世界纪录，最长的高达一小时之久。

sentences.en: Parkrun is succeeding where London's Olympic "legacy" is failing.
sentences.cn: “公园跑”的成功之处正是伦敦奥运会“遗产”的失败之处。

sentences.en: Ten years ago on Monday, it was announced that the Games of the 30th Olympiad would be in London.
sentences.cn: 十年前的那个星期一，（国际奥委会）宣布第 30 届奥林匹克运动会将在伦敦举行。

sentences.en: Planning documents pledged that the great legacy of the Games would be to lever a nation of sport lovers away from their couches.
sentences.cn: 规划文件承诺，奥运会的伟大遗产将会是把全国的体育爱好者撬离沙发。

sentences.en: The population would be fitter, healthier and produce more winners.
sentences.cn: 国民将会更强壮，更健康，产生更多获胜者。

sentences.en: It has not happened.
sentences.cn: 但这并没有发生。

sentences.en: The number of adults doing weekly sport did rise, by nearly 2 million in the run-up to 2012 - but the general population was growing faster.
sentences.cn: 在 2012 年前的筹备阶段，每周参加体育运动的成年人数量确实上升了，增加了近 200 万——但总人口增长得更快。

sentences.en: Worse, the numbers are now falling at an accelerating rate.
sentences.cn: 更糟糕的是，这一数字如今正以加速的势头下降。

sentences.en: The opposition claims primary school pupils doing at least two hours of sport a week have nearly halved.
sentences.cn: 反对党声称，每周至少参加两小时体育运动的小学生人数已近乎减半。

sentences.en: Obesity has risen among adults and children.
sentences.cn: 成年人和儿童中的肥胖率均有所上升。

sentences.en: Official retrospections continue as to why London 2012 failed to "inspire a generation."
sentences.cn: 关于 2012 年伦敦奥运会为何未能“激励一代人”，官方的反思仍在继续。

sentences.en: The success of Parkrun offers answers.
sentences.cn: “公园跑”的成功给出了答案。

sentences.en: Parkun is not a race but a time trial: Your only competitor is the clock.
sentences.cn: “公园跑”不是竞赛，而是计时赛：你唯一的竞争对手便是时间。

sentences.en: The ethos welcomes anybody.
sentences.cn: 其精神在于欢迎任何人。

sentences.en: There is as much joy over a puffed-out first-timer being clapped over the line as there is about top talent shining.
sentences.cn: 气喘吁吁的初次参加者在掌声中跨过终点时，获得的快乐与光芒四射的顶尖天才一样多。

sentences.en: The Olympic bidders, by contrast, wanted to get more people doing sport and to produce more elite athletes.
sentences.cn: 相比之下，奥运会申办者则希望让更多人参与运动且产生更多的精英运动员。

sentences.en: The dual aim was mixed up: The stress on success over taking part was intimidating for newcomers.
sentences.cn: 双重目的被混为一谈：强调“成功”胜过“参与”会吓退新手。

sentences.en: Indeed, there is something a little absurd in the state getting involved in the planning of such a fundamentally "grassroots" concept as community sports associations.
sentences.cn: 的确，政府参与规划“社区体育协会”这样本质上“草根”的概念有点荒唐。

sentences.en: If there is a role for government, it should really be getting involved in providing common goods - making sure there is space for playing fields and the money to pave tennis and netball courts, and encouraging the provision of all these activities in schools.
sentences.cn: 如果政府要起点作用，那其实应该是努力提供公共物品——确保有运动场地的空间，有铺筑网球、篮网球场的资金，并支持学校开展所有这些体育活动。

sentences.en: But successive governments have presided over selling green spaces, squeezing money from local authorities and declining attention on sport in education.
sentences.cn: 但是历届政府却一直掌管着售卖绿地，压缩地方政府资金，拒绝重视教育领域的体育运动。

sentences.en: Instead of wordy, worthy strategies, future governments need to do more to provide the conditions for sport to thrive.
sentences.cn: 未来政府不是要制定冗长的、令人尊敬的策略，而是需要多干实事，为繁荣体育运动提供条件。

sentences.en: Or at least not make them worse.
sentences.cn: 或者至少不要让情况变得更糟。

sentences.en: With so much focus on children's use of screens, it's easy for parents to forget about their own screen use.
sentences.cn: 随着儿童使用数字产品备受关注，父母很容易忽视他们自己对数字产品的使用。

sentences.en: "Tech is designed to really suck you in," says Jenny Radesky in her study of digital play, "and digital products are there to promote maximal engagement."
sentences.cn: “科技旨在真正让你卷入其中，”珍妮·拉德斯基在她的数字消遣研究中说道，“而且数字产品是为了促进最大参与度。”

sentences.en: It makes it hard to disengage, and leads to a lot of bleed-over into the family routine.
sentences.cn: 这种沉迷使人很难脱身，而且大量渗透到家庭日常生活中。

sentences.en: Radesky has studied the use of mobile phones and tablets at mealtimes by giving mother-child pairs a food-testing exercise.
sentences.cn: 通过让多对母子参与食物测试任务，拉德斯基研究了进餐时段手机和平板电脑的使用情况。

sentences.en: She found that mothers who used devices during the exercise started 20 per cent fewer verbal and 39 per cent fewer nonverbal interactions with their children.
sentences.cn: 她发现，在任务期间使用数字设备的母亲与孩子进行语言交流的频率降低了 20%，进行非语言交流的频率降低了 39%。

sentences.en: During a separate observation, she saw that phones became a source of tension in the family.
sentences.cn: 在另外一次观察中，她发现手机成了家庭紧张关系的根源。

sentences.en: Parents would be looking at their emails while the children would be making excited bids for their attention.
sentences.cn: 当孩子们紧张不安地企图获得父母的注意时，父母们却在查看电子邮件。

sentences.en: Infants are wired to look at parents' faces to try to understand their world, and if those faces are blank and unresponsive - as they often are when absorbed in a device - it can be extremely disconcerting for the children.
sentences.cn: 婴幼儿生来就靠观察父母的面孔来理解世界，如果这些面孔毫无表情也无任何反应——就像他们沉浸在数字设备时经常就是如此——这会让孩子感到非常不安。

sentences.en: Radesky cites the "still face experiment" devised by developmental psychologist Ed Tronick in the 1970s.
sentences.cn: 拉德斯基引用了 20 世纪 70 年代发展心理学家爱德华·特罗尼克设计的“面无表情实验”。

sentences.en: In it, a mother is asked to interact with her child in a normal way before putting on a blank expression and not giving them any visual social feedback: The child becomes increasingly distressed as she tries to capture her mother's attention.
sentences.cn: 在实验中，母亲被要求先以正常方式与孩子交流，之后摆出一副面无表情的神情并且不给孩子任何视觉上的社交反馈：孩子会因试图获得母亲的注意而变得越来越痛苦。

sentences.en: "Parents don't have to be exquisitely present at all times, but there needs to be a balance and parents need to be responsive and sensitive to a child's verbal or nonverbal expressions of an emotional need," says Radesky.
sentences.cn: “父母不必时刻都无微不至地陪伴，但需要有一种平衡，父母需要对孩子言语或非言语的情感需求作出回应并保持敏感，”拉德斯基说道。

sentences.en: On the other hand, Tronick himself is concerned that the worries about kids' use of screens are born out of an "oppressive ideology that demands that parents should always be interacting" with their children:
sentences.cn: 另一方面，特罗尼克自己担心对于孩子们使用数字产品的各种担忧是出于一种“要求父母一直与孩子保持交流的压制性的意识形态”：

sentences.en: "It's based on a somewhat fantasised, very white, very upper-middle-class ideology that says if you're failing to expose your child to 30,000 words you are neglecting them."
sentences.cn: “它基于一种有点儿幻想成分、非常符合白人和中上阶层价值观念的意识形态，认为如果你与孩子的语言交流未达到 3 万词汇，你就是在忽视他们。”

sentences.en: Tronick believes that just because a child isn't learning from the screen doesn't mean there's no value to it - particularly if it gives parents time to have a shower, do housework or simply have a break from their child.
sentences.cn: 特罗尼克认为，仅仅因为孩子没有从数字产品上学到东西并不意味着它没有任何价值——特别是如果它能让父母有时间去洗澡、做家务或只是暂时离开孩子休息一下。

sentences.en: Parents, he says, can get a lot out of using their devices to speak to a friend or get some work out of the way.
sentences.cn: 他说道，父母们可以从使用数字设备与朋友交谈或者处理完一些工作中获益良多。

sentences.en: This can make them feel happier, which lets them be more available to their child the rest of the time.
sentences.cn: 这能使他们感到更加幸福，让他们在其余时间里更有闲暇陪伴孩子。

sentences.en: Today, widespread social pressure to immediately go to college in conjunction with increasingly high expectations in a fast-moving world often causes students to completely overlook the possibility of taking a gap year.
sentences.cn: 如今，（高中毕业后）即刻升入大学这一普遍社会压力，加之快速发展的世界（对人们）越来越高的期望，往往导致学生们完全忽略了经历间隔年这一选择。

sentences.en: After all, if everyone you know is going to college in the fall, it seems silly to stay back a year, doesn't it?
sentences.cn: 毕竟，如果你认识的每个人都将在秋季步入大学，你一个人延迟一年入学似乎很傻，不是吗？

sentences.en: And after going to school for 12 years, it doesn't feel natural to spend a year doing something that isn't academic.
sentences.cn: 而且在上了 12 年学之后，花一年时间做学习之外的事也感觉不大正常。

sentences.en: But while this may be true, it's not a good enough reason to condemn gap years.
sentences.cn: 但这即使是事实，也不足以成为谴责间隔年的理由。

sentences.en: There's always a constant fear of falling behind everyone else on the socially perpetuated "race to the finish line," whether that be toward graduate school, medical school or a lucrative career.
sentences.cn: 在全社会一直延续着“向终点冲刺的比赛”，无论终点是研究生院、医学院还是赚钱的职业，人们永远有一种落于人后的担忧。

sentences.en: But despite common misconceptions, a gap year does not hinder the success of academic pursuits - in fact, it probably enhances it.
sentences.cn: 然而，尽管存在许多误解，间隔年其实不会阻碍学术事业的成功——实际上，它很可能助人成功。

sentences.en: Studies from the United States and Australia show that students who take a gap year are generally better prepared for and perform better in college than those who do not.
sentences.cn: 美国和澳大利亚的研究表明，经历过间隔年的学生普遍比没经历过间隔年的学生对大学有更充分的准备，表现也更好。

sentences.en: Rather than pulling students back, a gap year pushes them ahead by preparing them for independence, new responsibilities and environmental changes - all things that first-year students often struggle with the most.
sentences.cn: 间隔年不仅不会使学生退步，反而能让学生在独立、新的责任和环境变化方面——这些都是一年级学生往往最为纠结的事情——做好更充分的准备，从而助其进步。

sentences.en: Gap year experiences can lessen the blow when it comes to adjusting to college and being thrown into a brand new environment, making it easier to focus on academics and activities rather than acclimation blunders.
sentences.cn: 间隔年经历可以减轻适应大学生活和陷入全新环境所带来的冲击，使学生更容易专注于学业和活动，而不必为适应问题分心。

sentences.en: If you're not convinced of the inherent value in taking a year off to explore interests, then consider its financial impact on future academic choices.
sentences.cn: 如果你不相信休学一年具有发掘兴趣的内在价值，那么就想想它对于未来学业选择的经济影响吧。

sentences.en: According to the National Center for Education Statistics, nearly 80 percent of college students end up changing their majors at least once.
sentences.cn: 根据（美国）国家教育统计中心的数据，约 80% 的大学生最后都至少转过一次专业。

sentences.en: This isn't surprising, considering the basic mandatory high school curriculum leaves students with a poor understanding of the vast academic possibilities that await them in college.
sentences.cn: 鉴于高中强制性基础课程使学生对于大学里广阔的学术选择知之甚少，这并不奇怪。

sentences.en: Many students find themselves listing one major on their college applications, but switching to another after taking college classes.
sentences.cn: 许多学生发现自己在大学申请书中填报了一个专业，上过大学课程之后却转到了另一个专业。

sentences.en: It's not necessarily a bad thing, but depending on the school, it can be costly to make up credits after switching too late in the game.
sentences.cn: 这并不一定是坏事，但是根据学校的不同，由于转专业太晚，补学分的费用可能会很高。

sentences.en: At Boston College, for example, you would have to complete an extra year were you to switch to the nursing school from another department.
sentences.cn: 例如，在波士顿学院，如果你要从其他院系转到护理学院的话，就必须再多读一年。

sentences.en: Taking a gap year to figure things out initially can help prevent stress and save money later on.
sentences.cn: 选择间隔年一开始就把事情理顺有助于预防压力，之后还能省钱。

sentences.en: Though often viewed as a problem for western states, the growing frequency of wildfires is a national concern because of its impact on federal tax dollars, says Professor Max Moritz, a specialist in fire ecology and management.
sentences.cn: 日益频繁的森林大火尽管常常被视为西部州的棘手问题，但由于它对联邦税款的影响而成为一件举国关切之事，林火生态与管理专家马克斯·莫里茨教授说。

sentences.en: In 2015, the US Forest Service for the first time spent more than half of its $5.5 billion annual budget fighting fires - nearly double the percentage it spent on such efforts 20 years ago.
sentences.cn: 2015 年，美国林务局首次将其年度预算总额 55 亿美元中的过半用于抗击林火——几乎是 20 年前在这方面支出比例的两倍。

sentences.en: In effect, fewer federal funds today are going towards the agency's other work - such as forest conservation, watershed and cultural resources management, and infrastructure upkeep - that affect the lives of all Americans.
sentences.cn: 事实上，现在更少的联邦基金被投放到该机构的其他工作，诸如森林保护、集水区及文化资源管理、以及基础设施养护等，这些工作影响到全美国人民的生活。

sentences.en: Another nationwide concern is whether public funds from other agencies are going into construction in fire-prone districts.
sentences.cn: 另一件举国关切之事是，来自其他机构的公共基金是否被用于火灾易发区建设。

sentences.en: As Moritz puts it, how often are federal dollars building homes that are likely to be lost to a wildfire?
sentences.cn: 以莫里茨的话来讲就是，联邦资金用于建设那些可能会被毁于林火的家园的频率如何。

sentences.en: "It's already a huge problem from a public expenditure perspective for the whole country," he says.
sentences.cn: “从公共支出角度看，这对整个国家来说已然是一个巨大的难题，”他说。

sentences.en: "We need to take a magnifying glass to that. Like, 'Wait a minute, is this OK?' Do we want instead to redirect those funds to concentrate on lower-hazard parts of the landscape?"
sentences.cn: “对此，我们要用放大镜来看待。比如，‘等一下，这样做可行吗？’我们是否想反过来，将这些资金重新导向，集中用于地景中危险较低的部分呢？”

sentences.en: Such a view would require a corresponding shift in the way US society today views fire, researchers say.
sentences.cn: 研究者说，这种观念需要当今美国社会在看待火灾的方式上做出相应改变。

sentences.en: For one thing, conversations about wildfires need to be more inclusive.
sentences.cn: 首先，关于森林大火的晤谈应该更具包容性。

sentences.en: Over the past decade, the focus has been on climate change - how the warming of the Earth from greenhouse gases is leading to conditions that worsen fires.
sentences.cn: 在过去的十来年间，晤谈一直聚焦于气候变化——温室气体所致的地球变暖如何诱发使火灾恶化的环境。

sentences.en: While climate is a key element, Moritz says, it shouldn't come at the expense of the rest of the equation.
sentences.cn: 莫里茨说，尽管气候是一个关键要素，但它不应以牺牲其他影响因素作为代价。

sentences.en: "The human systems and the landscapes we live on are linked, and the interactions go both ways," he says.
sentences.cn: “人类系统与我们所赖以生存的地景相互关联，而且，两者间的相互影响是双向的，”他说。

sentences.en: Failing to recognize that, he notes, leads to "an overly simplified view of what the solutions might be. Our perception of the problem and of what the solution is becomes very limited."
sentences.cn: 他指出，不能认识到这一点会导致“对可能的解决措施的看法过于简化，对问题的认知以及对问题解决办法的认知变得极其有限”。

sentences.en: At the same time, people continue to treat fire as an event that needs to be wholly controlled and unleashed only out of necessity, says Professor Balch at the University of Colorado.
sentences.cn: 然而，人们仍旧把火灾视为需要全面控制且唯有必要方可释放的事件，科罗拉多大学鲍尔奇教授说。

sentences.en: But acknowledging fire's inevitable presence in human life is an attitude crucial to developing the laws, policies, and practices that make it as safe as possible, she says.
sentences.cn: 但是，承认火灾在人类生活中的必然存在这一态度对于形成确保火灾尽可能安全的法律、政策、惯例至关重要，她说。

sentences.en: "We've disconnected ourselves from living with fire," Balch says.
sentences.cn: “我们已将自身从与火灾共存中剥离开来，”鲍尔奇说。

sentences.en: "It is really important to understand and try and tease out what is the human connection with fire today."
sentences.cn: “理解并尽力梳理出当今人类与火灾之间的关联非常重要。”

sentences.en: It is curious that Stephen Koziatek feels almost as though he has to justify his efforts to give his students a better future.
sentences.cn: 令人好奇的是，Stephen Koziatek 几乎感觉自己似乎必须为“努力给学生一个更好的未来”这件事辩护一番。

sentences.en: Mr. Koziatek is part of something pioneering.
sentences.cn: Koziatek 先生是某一开创性行动的一部分。

sentences.en: He is a teacher at a New Hampshire high school where learning is not something of books and tests and mechanical memorization, but practical.
sentences.cn: 他任教于新罕布什尔州一所高中，在这里，学习不是关乎书本、测试以及机械记忆，而是关乎实践。

sentences.en: When did it become accepted wisdom that students should be able to name the 13th president of the United States but be utterly overwhelmed by a broken bike chain?
sentences.cn: 究竟何时人们开始普遍认为，学生就该叫得出美国第 13 任总统的名字，却面对断裂的自行车链完全不知所措？

sentences.en: As Koziatek knows, there is learning in just about everything.
sentences.cn: 正如 Koziatek 所知，几乎每件事中都有学问。

sentences.en: Nothing is necessarily gained by forcing students to learn geometry at a graffitied desk stuck with generations of discarded chewing gum.
sentences.cn: 在胡乱涂鸦的、沾满一届又一届学生丢弃的口香糖的桌子前学习几何，不一定能有任何收获。

sentences.en: They can also learn geometry by assembling a bicycle.
sentences.cn: 他们还可以通过安装自行车学习几何。

sentences.en: But he's also found a kind of insidious prejudice.
sentences.cn: 但他也发现了一种暗中为害的偏见。

sentences.en: Working with your hands is seen as almost a mark of inferiority.
sentences.cn: 用你的双手工作几乎被视为一种低劣的标记。

sentences.en: Schools in the family of vocational education "have that stereotype ... that it's for kids who can't make it academically," he says.
sentences.cn: 他说，职业教育家族的学校们“有这样一种模式化观念……它面向的是那些无法取得学业成功的孩子”。

sentences.en: On one hand, that viewpoint is a logical product of America's evolution.
sentences.cn: 一方面，那种观点是美国发展的合理产物。

sentences.en: Manufacturing is not the economic engine that it once was.
sentences.cn: 制造业已不再是曾经的经济引擎。

sentences.en: The job security that the US economy once offered to high school graduates has largely evaporated.
sentences.cn: 美国经济曾提供给高中毕业生的工作安稳很大程度上已逐渐消逝。

sentences.en: More education is the new principle.
sentences.cn: “更多教育”是如今的新原则。

sentences.en: We want more for our kids, and rightfully so.
sentences.cn: 我们想要孩子接受更多的教育，且理应如此。

sentences.en: But the headlong push into bachelor's degrees for all - and the subtle devaluing of anything less - misses an important point: That's not the only thing the American economy needs.
sentences.cn: 但慌不择路地将所有人椎进学士学位——并微妙地贬抑其他较低的一切——忽略了重要的一点：那并非美国经济唯一所需。

sentences.en: Yes, a bachelor's degree opens more doors.
sentences.cn: 确实，学士学位会打开更多扇门。

sentences.en: But even now, 54 percent of the jobs in the country are middle-skill jobs, such as construction and high-skill manufacturing.
sentences.cn: 但就算是现在，我们国家依然有 54% 的工作是中等技能工作，如建筑和高技能制造。

sentences.en: But only 44 percent of workers are adequately trained.
sentences.cn: 但仅有 44% 的工人接受过足够的培训。

sentences.en: In other words, at a time when the working class has turned the country on its political head, frustrated that the opportunity that once defined America is vanishing, one obvious solution is staring us in the face.
sentences.cn: 换言之，在一个“工人阶级已完全改变了这个国家的政治思路、因曾经定义美国的机会逐渐消逝而受挫”的时代，一个明显的解决办法一直就摆在我们的面前。

sentences.en: There is a gap in working-class jobs, but the workers who need those jobs most aren't equipped to do them.
sentences.cn: 工人阶级职位有缺口，但最需要这些工作的工人们并不具备做它们的能力。

sentences.en: Koziatek's Manchester School of Technology High School is trying to fill that gap.
sentences.cn: Koziatek 的曼彻斯特技术高中正在试图填补那一缺口。

sentences.en: Koziatek's school is a wake-up call.
sentences.cn: Koziatek 的学校敲响了警钟。

sentences.en: When education becomes one-size-fits-all, it risks overlooking a nation's diversity of gifts.
sentences.cn: 当教育变得一刀切时，它是在拿一国的天赋多样性冒险。

sentences.en: While fossil fuels - coal, oil, gas - still generate roughly 85 percent of the world's energy supply, it's clearer than ever that the future belongs to renewable sources such as wind and solar.
sentences.cn: 尽管化石燃料——煤炭、石油、天然气——仍约占世界能源总供应量的 85%，但未来属于风能、太阳能等可再生能源这一点要比以往任何时候都更明朗。

sentences.en: The move to renewables is picking up momentum around the world: They now account for more than half of new power sources going on line.
sentences.cn: 向可再生能源转型正在全球范围内升温：目前，可再生能源占据正在使用的新能源的一半以上。

sentences.en: Some growth stems from a commitment by governments and farsighted businesses to fund cleaner energy sources.
sentences.cn: 部分增长源于政府以及有远见的企业对更清洁能源承诺的资金支持。

sentences.en: But increasingly the story is about the plummeting prices of renewables, especially wind and solar.
sentences.cn: 但越来越多的情况是，故事关乎可再生能源——尤其是风能和太阳能——价格的暴跌。

sentences.en: The cost of solar panels has dropped by 80 percent and the cost of wind turbines by close to one-third in the past eight years.
sentences.cn: 过去八年间，太阳能电池板的成本下降了 80%，风力涡轮机的成本下降了近三分之一。

sentences.en: In many parts of the world renewable energy is already a principal energy source.
sentences.cn: 在世界很多地区，可再生能源已成为主要能源。

sentences.en: In Scotland, for example, wind turbines provide enough electricity to power 95 percent of homes.
sentences.cn: 比如，在苏格兰，风力涡轮机能为 95% 的家庭提供充足的电力。

sentences.en: While the rest of the world takes the lead, notably China and Europe, the United States is also seeing a remarkable shift.
sentences.cn: 在其他国家领先之际，尤其是中国和欧洲，美国也迎来了显著的转变。

sentences.en: In March, for the first time, wind and solar power accounted for more than 10 percent of the power generated in the US, reported the US Energy Information Administration.
sentences.cn: 据美国能源情报署报道，3 月美国风能、太阳能发电比重首次超过 10%。

sentences.en: President Trump has underlined fossil fuels - especially coal - as the path to economic growth.
sentences.cn: 特朗普总统强调化石燃料——尤其煤炭——作为经济发展的路径。

sentences.en: In a recent speech in Iowa, he dismissed wind power as an unreliable energy source.
sentences.cn: 在爱荷华州的最近一次演讲中，他将风能摒弃为不可靠的能源。

sentences.en: But that message did not play well with many in Iowa, where wind turbines dot the fields and provide 36 percent of the state's electricity generation - and where tech giants like Microsoft are being attracted by the availability of clean energy to power their data centers.
sentences.cn: 但这个说法在爱荷华州并不怎么被群众买账，该州的风力涡轮机遍布田野并且供应该州 36% 的发电量——微软等技术巨擘也被这里能为其数据中心供电的清洁能源的易获得性吸引。

sentences.en: The question "what happens when the wind doesn't blow or the sun doesn't shine?" has provided a quick put-down for skeptics.
sentences.cn: “如果不刮风、不出太阳，会发生什么？”这一问话为怀疑论者提供了一句快速的贬斥之辞。

sentences.en: But a boost in the storage capacity of batteries is making their ability to keep power flowing around the clock more likely.
sentences.cn: 但是，电池存储容量的提升正使其昼夜不停地持续供电的能力更有可能实现。

sentences.en: The advance is driven in part by vehicle manufacturers, who are placing big bets on battery-powered electric vehicles.
sentences.cn: 这一进展一定程度上是由汽车制造商推动的，他们在电池驱动的电动汽车上押下重注。

sentences.en: Although electric cars are still a rarity on roads now, this massive investment could change the picture rapidly in coming years.
sentences.cn: 尽管现在道路行驶中电动汽车依然鲜见，但是这笔巨额投资可能会在未来几年迅速改变这一局面。

sentences.en: While there's a long way to go, the trend lines for renewables are spiking.
sentences.cn: 尽管长路漫漫，但是可再生能源的趋势线在快速上扬。

sentences.en: The pace of change in energy sources appears to be speeding up - perhaps just in time to have a meaningful effect in slowing climate change.
sentences.cn: 能源的变化速度似乎在加快——或许正好能够给减缓气候变化带来积极影响。

sentences.en: What Washington does - or doesn't do - to promote alternative energy may mean less and less at a time of a global shift in thought.
sentences.cn: 在全球思想转型之际，无论华盛顿在推动可替代性能源中做什么或不做什么，其影响将愈来愈小。
